findings.proof: For every symbol, old code creates a HashSet for one mandatory and two optional string keys, then repeats file_path clone/hash once per distinct key.
findings.change: Deduplicate the bounded three keys using equality, look up the file map once, retain identical per-key index append order.
findings.cost: Removes one temporary set per symbol and up to two repeated file-key clone/hash operations; still O(number of symbols).

findings.proof: Old prefix helper collects both segment streams to Vec. Original import_distance_candidates computes this distance twice per candidate, once to select the maximum and again to filter.
findings.change: Lazy split/zip comparison, one distance per candidate, keep all current maximum ties, then invoke unchanged stable_candidates.
findings.cost: Two distance traversals become one, four temporary segment Vec constructions per candidate become zero; stable ordering and existing identity dedup remain unchanged. Worst-case candidate storage remains O(C).

findings.proof: scope_for_line collects matching scopes and sorts them by (span,start,scope_id), but returns only the first.
findings.change: Not changed in this candidate. A future min_by using the exact comparator could remove allocation and sorting; no bound or semantic alteration is proposed here.
findings.cost: Potential O(K log K) to O(K) over matches, with the same scope scan; benefit unmeasured.
